nodes.label: BBP Mode (Beast Binary Predictor)
nodes.rationale: Core prediction feature achieving 80%+ accuracy on 2-string predictions using pair transition matrix analysis.

nodes.label: Warp Analyzer
nodes.rationale: Analyzes pull data from external sources like StarRailStation.com using Z-Score peak detection.

nodes.label: PvP Bot and Roll System
nodes.rationale: Simulates human manipulation behavior for relic upgrading competitions.

nodes.label: Expert V2 Bot
nodes.rationale: Tests whether a bot can manually create session data and decide if a read is trustworthy before committing.

nodes.label: Raw Pair Manipulation Logic
nodes.rationale: Raw pairs represent true line-to-line movement, while visible rolls are translated results.

nodes.label: OpenCode Design System
nodes.rationale: Design system inspired by OpenCode's terminal-native, monospace-first aesthetic. Chosen to reflect CLI-first identity using Berkeley Mono, warm near-black (#201d1d), and flat depth system with no shadows.

nodes.label: Evanescia Hellfire Masquerade Theme
nodes.rationale: Theme for HSR character Evanescia (ID 1505, Patch 4.3, Path Elation). Color palette uses deep void black + theatrical crimson + hellfire orange-amber + ghostly pearl white to match character identity as a dark theatrical phantom.

nodes.label: Kiyo Mode (3-String Predictor)
nodes.rationale: Kiyo mode focuses on 3-string pair logic for 5-minute sessions. Scope is only 2-string and 3-string predictions. Top-2 is the real target; top-3 is only a sanity metric.

nodes.label: Seed Assist (Kiyo)
nodes.rationale: Seed weight is disabled once there are 5+ live rolls to prevent imported/sheet rolls from behaving like live rolls.

nodes.label: Kiyo DB Layer Proposal
nodes.rationale: Proposal to save Kiyo rolls into a secondary DB (Turso) as a prediction dataset. Retains only the latest 2 patches to avoid stale PRNG behavior poisoning reads. Rollout order: collect only -> shadow weight -> replay validate -> co-primary -> DB primary -> retire sheet.

nodes.label: Turso Secondary DB
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Supabase because current Supabase project is at ~381MB/500MB free tier. Turso free tier = 9GB, serverless SQLite. Keeps Kiyo growth isolated from main app (auth, Clara, Discord bot).

nodes.label: Source Tagging (Roll Provenance)
nodes.rationale: Every roll entering Kiyo needs explicit source before saving: live_manual | import_paste | sheet_seed | caesar_helper | debug_replay. Without this, DB layer silently mixes good live data with stale/imported data.

nodes.label: Svarog Predictor
nodes.rationale: 2-string live predictor for 5-minute sessions. Noise rate ~45%. Top-2 accuracy improved from 64% to 70% via transition override targeting weak patterns (44->43, 43->43).

nodes.label: svarogNoisePredictor.js
nodes.rationale: Standalone stateless module answering: when will noise hit, which noise value, at what confidence. Uses transition probability (0.45), gap ratio sigmoid (0.25), recent noise rate (0.15), run length (0.10), session age (0.05). Absence multiplier 8.0 for never-seen values.

nodes.label: Noise Gap Analysis
nodes.rationale: Average gap between noise appearances is ~3-4 common rolls. When commonsSinceNoise/avgNoiseGap > 1.5 noise likelihood rises sharply. Ratio >4.0-6.0 means noise almost guaranteed.

nodes.label: Transition Override (44->43, 43->43)
nodes.rationale: Removes lastRoll from top-2 on historically weak transitions. Only 44->43 and 43->43 are enabled; 42->42 and 41->41 caused regressions on smaller sample sizes.

nodes.label: Cloudinary Migration Plan
nodes.rationale: Migration of local assets (~38 images, ~49 audio) and external game images (725+) to Cloudinary CDN for image optimization (f_auto,q_auto), CDN delivery, and reduced GitHub repo size.

nodes.label: Wave Theory (EU Pattern Method)
nodes.rationale: 3-string outcomes are split into pairs. After hitting one pair's outcomes several times, it flips to the other pair. EU uses this as bread-and-butter. NA/ASIA are different (more pattern-based, 2-string commons).

nodes.norm_label: z digit pair systems (low/high, outer/inner, odd/even)

nodes.label: scripts/eval-kiyo-pair-read.mjs
nodes.rationale: Replay harness for measuring pair engine accuracy. First honest measurement: 49.5% side-hit, 17.2% top-2 before backbone patch. After backbone patch: 59.1% side-hit, 28.0% top-2.

nodes.label: Session Backbone Selector (Kiyo)
nodes.rationale: Replaced binary run-length switch logic with backbone approach: locks onto two strongest live prefixes as active side. Improved side-hit from 49.5% to 59.1%. Next target: top-2 > 35%, side-hit > 62%.

nodes.label: SWITCH Aggression Problem (Kiyo)
nodes.rationale: Binary currentRun.length >= N => SWITCH rule fired 87/93 decisions (93%), but STAY decisions performed better (33.3% top-2 vs 16.1% for SWITCH). Fix: replace with hold/switch pressure model.

nodes.label: Prediction Data Hierarchy (User -> Region -> Global -> Sheet)
nodes.rationale: Strict priority: 1. User's own saved history, 2. Region patch data, 3. Global patch data, 4. Sheet fallback. Confidence gated by event count and distinct users per layer.
nodes.norm_label: prediction data hierarchy (user -> region -> global -> sheet)

nodes.label: Batch Save API (POST /session)
nodes.rationale: Batch save chosen over per-roll API calls to reduce request volume. Rolls accumulate locally then sync as one POST. Fewer requests, cleaner data integrity, user consent.

nodes.label: noiseTrap Injection Plan
nodes.rationale: System computes isNoiseTrap but does nothing with it in prediction (only shows UI strip). Fix: inject trapCandidate into alt when isNoiseTrap && pairLinkPct >= 20, or into main on degraded boards.

nodes.label: Degraded Board Analyzer-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: On degraded boards, run analyzer first and let main predictor challenge only with clear non-stale signal. Reverses burden of proof from main predictor to analyzer on degraded boards.

nodes.label: shouldPreserveAdaptiveCommons Guard
nodes.rationale: Guard has no awareness of commonsSwitch. Fix: add if (commonsSwitch && commonsSwitch.detected) return false to avoid reverting to old commons during a detected switch.

nodes.label: 2 String Pattern Recognition
nodes.rationale: Watches each column's green/amber table rhythm. Tested as a direct math override but lowered 2-string accuracy from 60% to 57%. Used as a breaker/confirmation layer only, not a hard override.

nodes.label: Vercel API Function (api/existing-route.js)
nodes.rationale: Existing Vercel function reused as router for Kiyo Turso handling. Vercel Hobby cap is 12/12 serverless functions so no new function files can be added.
